mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS subscriptionId, s.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS memberNickname, m.email AS memberEmail, s.target_id AS targetId, t.nickname AS targetNickname, c.name AS subscriptionStatus, s.price_id AS priceId, s.started_at AS startedAt, COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.next_billing_at, DATE_ADD(s.started_at, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS endedAt, s.next_billing_at AS nextBillingAt, s.payment_id AS paymentId FROM subscription s JOIN member m ON s.member_id = m.id JOIN member t ON s.target_id = t.id JOIN common_code c ON s.status_id = c.id WHERE c.type = 4 AND c.code = 'SS01' ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC
